name: gradient-eternal-constance

frames.best_why: All frames look the same; frame 1 shows the whole rounded gradient panel cleanly.

tagline: Deep navy fading up into muted slate blue, as a rounded panel.
summary: A static two-stop gradient block: dark navy along the bottom rising to slate blue at the top, shaped as a full-width rounded panel that can sit behind content or fill a section.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle centred on a near-black stage, filled with a smooth vertical gradient. The top edge is a soft grey-blue and it darkens steadily to almost black-navy at the bottom, with softly rounded corners.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. The same gradient is shown in every frame.
use_when: You need a calm dark gradient surface behind text or as a section and card fill.
avoid_when: The colours are fixed in the source, so a light theme or a different palette needs an edit.
customise: Pass className or style to change size and override the gradient; the two colour stops are written into the file.
weight_why: A single div painted with one CSS gradient; no script or animation.

a11y.note: Decorative gradient with no interactive content, so there is nothing to focus, label or announce.

issues: Packet calls the footprint full-bleed but the frames show a rounded panel inset from the stage.
polish_why: Clean smooth gradient with even corners; ordinary and nothing distinctive.
